ORDER This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner challenging the st impugned reference order passed by the 1 respondent in Ref.No.RC. 32/2012 dated 19.02.2024.

2.Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the reference order st in RC.No.32/2012 dated 19.02.2024 has been passed by the 1 respondent directing the Sub-Judge, Kancheepuram to take the petitioner's case for determination of compensation on file and dispose of the same.
As per the reference order dated 19.02.2024, the Land Acquisition Original Petition was numbered as LAOP.No.7 of 2024 on the file of the Subordinate Court, Kancheepuram.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

( Uploaded on: 29/10/2025 05:56:01 pm )
3.He would further submit that as per Section 53 (a) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Tamil Nadu Amendment) Act,
2014, the appropriate Authority to determine the compensation is jurisdicational District Judge and therefore, the matter has to be referred only to the Principal District Court, Kanceepuram.

sentences.text: Hence, he prayed to quash the impugned reference order dated 19.02.2024 with a direction to the 1st respondent to refer the matter to the Principal District Court, Kanceepuram.

4.Learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would fairly submit that the reference order was made to the Sub-Judge, Kancheepuram instead of Principal District Judge,
Kancheepuram.

Hence, he prayed to pass appropriate orders to Sub-Judge, Kancheepuram to transfer Land Acquisition Original Petition in LAOP.No.7 of 2024 to the Principal District Court,
Kancheepuram.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 29/10/2025 05:56:01 pm )
5.Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents and perused the materials available on record.

6.Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents, it is evident that the reference order dated 19.02.2024 was passed by the 1st respondent to the Sub-Judge, Kancheepuram to take the petitioner's case for determination of compensation on file and dispose of the same.

However, as per Section 53 (a) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Tamil Nadu Amendment) Act, 2014, the appropriate Authority to determine the compensation is jurisdicational District Judge and the reference has to be made only P.S.Kumar vs The District Collector on 6 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90829872/
3 to the Principal District Court, Kancheepuram.

In which case, the Principal District Judge, Kancheepuram is directed to take the LAOP.No.7 of 2024 on record and pass appropriate orders, on merits and in accordance with law.
7.With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
